subject.title: fix(agents): deliver the sessions_yield message instead of a silent spawn-and-wait turn

question: Should the shipped `sessions_yield.message` argument become recipient-visible by default, or remain hidden with a new explicit acknowledgment field for external delivery?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and well-proven, but repository history defines the existing argument as next-turn context, making this a product and compatibility choice rather than a routine bug fix.

options.title: Add explicit acknowledgment
options.body: Preserve `message` as hidden context and add a separate model-facing field whose contract is external delivery on otherwise silent interactive yields.

options.title: Redefine message as visible
options.body: Approve the compatibility change, document the visibility contract, and add upgrade-focused tests for internal, heartbeat, subagent, and already-delivered paths.

options.title: Keep current semantics
options.body: Leave `message` hidden, close both candidate PRs, and improve tool guidance so agents send a normal reply or message-tool acknowledgment before yielding.

recommendation.title: Add explicit acknowledgment
recommendation.body: Preserve `message` as hidden context and add a separate model-facing field whose contract is external delivery on otherwise silent interactive yields.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed the original semantic boundary, proposed the attempt-result architecture, and merged the shipped feature.
